title: Keep the even numbers

blocks.text: The enhanced `for` loop visits every element in order: `for (int num : numbers) { ... }`. The course's `filterEvenNumbers` uses it twice, once to count and once to copy.
Write `evens(int[] numbers)` in `Evens`. It returns a new array of the even numbers, in their original order, duplicates kept:

items: `evens({1, 3, 5})` and `evens({})` are `{}`, an empty array, never `null`.

cases.says: The even numbers are kept, in order.
{6, 2, 2, 4} stays {6, 2, 2, 4}: order and duplicates are kept.
{1, 3, 5} and {} give an empty array, not null.

concepts: An empty array or collection is handled gracefully and gives an empty result, not an error.
The enhanced for loop visits every element of an array or collection in order, without an index.
